title: Alive With Their Lord, and Every Soul Dies

paragraphs.text: Do not think those killed in Allah's cause are dead. They are alive with their Lord. They receive provision and are happy. Some believers answered Allah even after injury. People told them to fear the army against them. But their faith grew stronger. "Allah is enough for us," they said. Satan makes you fear his friends. Fear Allah instead.

Do not be sad about those who rush to disbelief. They cannot harm Allah. More time only lets them grow in sin. Allah will separate the bad from the good. Some hold back what Allah gave them. That is worse for them.

"Allah is poor, and we are rich," some said. Allah recorded their words. Messengers before were also denied. Every soul will taste death. Full reward comes on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever is saved from the Fire has truly won. This worldly life is only a deceiving enjoyment.

hardWords.m: the inner self of a person
